children: Change Agents completed several financing actions. The company raised $250,000 in gross proceeds through original issue discount notes on Sep 08 2026 and issued 1,000,000 pre-funded warrants as an inducement. On Sep 09 2026, it amended its $10 million equity line with Hudson Global Ventures to set a $2.00 share price and updated put tiers, subject to a 19.99% exchange cap pending stockholder approval. To permit the new notes, Change Agents secured waivers from Dune Equity Holdings and FirstFire Opportunities Fund, issuing pre-funded warrants and agreeing to buyout rights if stockholder approval is not obtained within 90 days.
